messages: SELECT messages.project,'conversation',id,'conversation',role,content FROM messages WHERE messages.project=? AND status IN ('complete','partial','imported')
notes: SELECT notes.project,'note',id,'note','Research note',content FROM notes WHERE notes.project=?
tasks: SELECT tasks.project,'analysis',id,'result',kind,COALESCE(result,'') FROM tasks WHERE tasks.project=? AND state IN ('completed','imported') AND kind!='chat'
files: SELECT files.project,'file',files.id,json_extract(j.value,'$.location'),name,json_extract(j.value,'$.text') FROM files JOIN json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(extracted) THEN extracted ELSE '{}' END,'$.segments') j WHERE files.project=? AND json_valid(extracted)
